title: Music Conservatory Circle
description: Four musicians at a Nashville conservatory connected through duet partnerships, teaching, shared housing, and a band. Rich in musical details, performance history, and creative collaborations.

people.name: Harper Reeves
people.profile: Classically trained but drawn to bluegrass. Grew up on a farm in rural Kentucky. Plays in a band with Leo and studies under Professor Miriam Soto.

observations.text: Harper Reeves grew up on a 120-acre tobacco farm outside Lexington, Kentucky.
Harper Reeves started playing violin at age 5 after her grandmother gave her a quarter-size fiddle.
Harper Reeves and Leo Nakamura are duet partners and perform together every Friday at the Bluebird Cafe.
Harper Reeves is a roommate of Sienna Ortiz at the Belmont Place Apartments on 16th Avenue South.
Harper Reeves won first place in the Appalachian Fiddle Championship in Galax, Virginia in August 2023.
Harper Reeves plays fiddle in a folk-rock band called Copper Ridge with Leo Nakamura and two other students.
Harper Reeves is taking private lessons from Professor Miriam Soto, who also teaches Sienna Ortiz.
Harper Reeves's mother, June Reeves, teaches elementary school music in Lexington.
Harper Reeves drives a green 2015 Subaru Outback with a 'Keep Kentucky Wild' bumper sticker.
Harper Reeves performed at the Grand Ole Opry as part of a student showcase in March 2024.
Harper Reeves can play violin, mandolin, and banjo.
Harper Reeves recorded a demo EP with three original bluegrass songs at Sound Emporium Studios in January 2024.
Harper Reeves's favorite musician is Alison Krauss.
Harper Reeves volunteers every Saturday teaching violin to kids at the Nashville Rescue Mission.
Harper Reeves sprained her left wrist during a hiking trip to Fall Creek Falls in October 2023 and couldn't play for three weeks.
Harper Reeves is applying for a residency at the Tanglewood Music Center for summer 2025.
Harper Reeves owns a 1920s German-made Karl Hofner violin that belonged to her great-grandfather.
Harper Reeves's favorite restaurant in Nashville is Hattie B's Hot Chicken on 19th Avenue.
Harper Reeves organized a benefit concert at the Station Inn that raised $4,200 for the Nashville flood relief fund in April 2024.
Harper Reeves runs 3 miles every morning along the Shelby Bottoms Greenway before classes.

people.name: Leo Nakamura
people.profile: Self-taught jazz guitarist from Honolulu who transitioned to formal training. Plays in a band with Harper and takes songwriting classes with Devin.

observations.text: Leo Nakamura grew up in Honolulu, Hawaii, and learned to play guitar at age 12 by watching YouTube tutorials.
Leo Nakamura and Harper Reeves are duet partners and perform together every Friday at the Bluebird Cafe.
Leo Nakamura plays lead guitar in a folk-rock band called Copper Ridge with Harper Reeves.
Leo Nakamura and Devin Cross are enrolled in the same Advanced Songwriting Workshop taught by Professor Alan Michaels.
Leo Nakamura won the Nashville Jazz Guitar Competition in February 2024, earning a $2,500 scholarship.
Leo Nakamura's primary instrument is a 1965 Gibson ES-335 that his uncle gave him as a high school graduation gift.
Leo Nakamura works part-time three evenings a week as a session guitarist at Blackbird Studio.
Leo Nakamura's father, Ken Nakamura, is a marine biologist at the University of Hawaii.
Leo Nakamura speaks English and Japanese fluently.
Leo Nakamura recorded guitar tracks for a country album by singer Marla Bridges at Blackbird Studio in November 2023.
Leo Nakamura lives alone in a studio apartment on Music Row near the conservatory.
Leo Nakamura's favorite guitarist is Pat Metheny.
Leo Nakamura performed a solo jazz set at the Nashville Jazz Workshop on 4th Avenue in May 2024.
Leo Nakamura surfs whenever he visits his family in Honolulu and competed in the Waikiki Classic amateur competition in 2022.
Leo Nakamura composed the score for a short film called 'Tidepool' that screened at the Nashville Film Festival in April 2024.
Leo Nakamura rides a black 2021 Honda CB300R motorcycle to campus.
Leo Nakamura is writing a 12-song concept album about growing up in Hawaii, tentatively titled 'Trade Winds'.
Leo Nakamura taught Devin Cross basic jazz chord voicings during their weekly Tuesday practice sessions.
Leo Nakamura's favorite restaurant in Nashville is Nolensville Pike's International Market for its poke bowls.
Leo Nakamura was offered an internship at Blue Note Records in New York starting January 2025.

people.name: Sienna Ortiz
people.profile: Powerful vocalist from San Antonio with a flair for Tejano and R&B fusion. Roommate with Harper, mentored by the same professor.

observations.text: Sienna Ortiz grew up in San Antonio, Texas, and started singing in her church choir at age 7.
Sienna Ortiz is a roommate of Harper Reeves at the Belmont Place Apartments on 16th Avenue South.
Sienna Ortiz takes private voice lessons from Professor Miriam Soto, who also teaches Harper Reeves.
Sienna Ortiz and Devin Cross co-wrote a song called 'Neon Dust' that won the conservatory's annual songwriting prize in May 2024.
Sienna Ortiz released a three-song Tejano-R&B EP called 'Sangre y Sol' on Spotify in September 2023, which has over 85,000 streams.
Sienna Ortiz speaks English and Spanish fluently.
Sienna Ortiz's grandmother, Rosa Ortiz, was a semi-professional Tejano singer in Corpus Christi in the 1970s.
Sienna Ortiz performed the national anthem at a Nashville Predators hockey game in February 2024.
Sienna Ortiz works weekends as a vocal coach at School of Rock Nashville on West End Avenue.
Sienna Ortiz's vocal range spans from E3 to G#5.
Sienna Ortiz plays acoustic guitar and piano as accompaniment instruments.
Sienna Ortiz was chosen as the lead soprano in the conservatory's spring production of 'West Side Story' in April 2024.
Sienna Ortiz's favorite singer is Selena Quintanilla.
Sienna Ortiz's father, Miguel Ortiz, manages a car dealership in San Antonio.
Sienna Ortiz ran a GoFundMe campaign that raised $6,800 to fund studio time for her debut full-length album.
Sienna Ortiz practices yoga every morning at 6:30 AM at the Hot Yoga Nashville studio on 12th Avenue.
Sienna Ortiz is applying to the Artist-in-Residence program at the Kennedy Center for fall 2025.
Sienna Ortiz fostered and then adopted a tabby cat named Coda from the Nashville Humane Association.
Sienna Ortiz's favorite restaurant in Nashville is Mas Tacos Por Favor on Dickerson Pike.
Sienna Ortiz organized a Latin Music Night at the conservatory in November 2023 that featured 12 student performers.

people.name: Devin Cross
people.role: Music production major, electronic music producer
people.profile: Tech-savvy producer from Atlanta blending electronic and hip-hop. Takes songwriting with Leo and co-writes with Sienna.

observations.text: Devin Cross grew up in Atlanta, Georgia, and started producing beats on FL Studio at age 14.
Devin Cross and Leo Nakamura are enrolled in the same Advanced Songwriting Workshop taught by Professor Alan Michaels.
Devin Cross and Sienna Ortiz co-wrote a song called 'Neon Dust' that won the conservatory's annual songwriting prize in May 2024.
Devin Cross produces electronic and hip-hop music under the artist name 'DVNX'.
Devin Cross released a 10-track instrumental album called 'Signal Path' on Bandcamp in July 2023 that sold 340 copies.
Devin Cross DJs every Thursday night at The Basement East on Woodland Street under the name DVNX.
Devin Cross built a home studio in his apartment using $8,000 worth of equipment including a Universal Audio Apollo interface and Yamaha HS8 monitors.
Devin Cross's mother, Patricia Cross, is an entertainment lawyer in Atlanta.
Devin Cross won second place at the Red Bull Music 3Style DJ competition in Nashville in January 2024.
Devin Cross drives a matte black 2022 Tesla Model 3.
Devin Cross produced a remix for Atlanta rapper Kilo Watts that got 500,000 plays on SoundCloud in March 2024.
Devin Cross's favorite producer is Kaytranada.
Devin Cross taught himself to play synthesizer and owns a vintage Roland Juno-106.
Devin Cross attended the NAMM music trade show in Anaheim, California in April 2024.
Devin Cross and Harper Reeves collaborated on an experimental track blending bluegrass fiddle with electronic beats in June 2024.
Devin Cross mentors two freshman producers in the conservatory's peer coaching program.
Devin Cross has a younger brother named Marcus who plays basketball at Georgia State University.
Devin Cross is applying for an internship at Splice, the music production platform, for summer 2025.
Devin Cross learned basic jazz chord voicings from Leo Nakamura during their weekly Tuesday practice sessions.
Devin Cross's favorite restaurant in Nashville is Prince's Hot Chicken Shack on Ewing Drive.
